analysis: The method setup() is annotated with @BeforeClass and declares throws Exception. It calls setupMySQL(), service.registerForBus(), service.initialize(), and service.start(). From setupMySQL, runtime exceptions include SecurityException and IllegalArgumentException. These are unchecked exceptions. Since the method already declares throws Exception, it allows any exception (including runtime exceptions) to propagate to the caller. In a test setup context, such propagation is typically acceptable, causing the test to fail if an exception occurs. No explicit handling is required within this snippet.
